question: A car hits a solid wall at 60 km/h. From how many metres up would a dropped car reach that same speed?
move: Translate an unfamiliar quantity into one your body already knows.
trap: Guessing a few metres, since 60 km/h feels slow.
hint: Kinetic energy, half of mass times speed squared, equals mass times g times height; the mass cancels.
source: Halliday, Resnick and Walker, Fundamentals of Physics, 2013
reference: Halliday, Resnick & Walker, Fundamentals of Physics, Wiley, 2013
